name: windy-plugin-flight-route-analyzer
description: Direct Windy Distance & Planning deep-link from route plus GPX fallback; key-free Open-Meteo GFS profiles

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && SERVE=false rollup -c && cp package.json dist/package.json
scripts.typecheck:core: tsc --noEmit --target es2022 --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --lib es2022,dom --strict src/navdb.ts src/weather.ts src/tropopause.ts src/xplane.ts src/routePlanner.ts src/plannerPointNames.ts src/offlineReport.ts src/flightAltitude.ts src/profileChart.ts src/gpxDownload.ts src/windyDistanceLink.ts

scripts.test:release: npm run check:tree && npm run check:build-config && npm run check:imports && npm run check:exports && npm run typecheck:core && npm test && npm run build && npm run verify:release
